analytic_identities.gamma_zero: Classical forgetting/coarse-graining has no interference; q_s=sum_c |a_cs|^2.
analytic_identities.gamma_half: Every port effect is the convex average of gamma=0 and gamma=1 effects, hence completely positive.
analytic_identities.completed_eraser: Sum_(sign,s) E_sign,s = gain^2 sum_(c,s) a_cs^dagger a_cs for all states in E.
analytic_identities.phase_sensitive_cross_term: Re(exp(-i theta) gamma sum_s a_1s a_2s^*)
analytic_identities.coherent_dilation_required: The accepted map V= gain sum_(c,s) a_cs |c,s> before dephasing is a new coherent realization, not a unitary change of the already dephased Kraus list.
